human_decision.definition: Identify the declared instrument domain. Policy separately checks current affected-service relevance. Missing or ambiguous declarations establish no domain.

construction: Fresh generic, technical-distraction, missing/ambiguous declaration and eligibility pairs. Instrument declaration is an input fact supplied consistently in prose and structured metadata. Trust, contradictory declarations and incorrect metadata are not tested. Two graph/impact variants share texts; one prediction per distinct text is reused across occurrences.
